chunks: ʿAlī ibn Muḥammad, from some of our companions, from Ibn Maḥbūb, from Muḥammad ibn al-Fuḍayl, from Abū al-Ḥasan al-Māḍī عليه السلام, who said:

I asked him about the saying of Allah, Mighty and Majestic: “They desire to extinguish the light of Allah with their mouths.” He said: “They desire to extinguish the wilayah of Amīr al-Muʾminīn عليه السلام with their mouths.” I said: “And Allah will complete His light?” He said: “And Allah will complete the Imamate,” due to His saying, Mighty and Majestic: “Those who believe in Allah and His Messenger and the light which We sent down” — so the light is the Imam.

I said: “He it is Who sent His Messenger with guidance and the religion of truth.” He said: “He is the One Who commanded His Messenger with the wilayah of his legatee, and the wilayah is the religion of truth.” I said: “That He may make it prevail over all religion?” He said: “He will make it prevail over all religions at the rise of al-Qāʾim.”

He said: “Allah says: ‘And Allah will complete His light’ — the wilayah of al-Qāʾim — ‘though the disbelievers dislike’ the wilayah of ʿAlī.” I said: “Is this revelation?” He said: “Yes. As for this wording, it is revelation; and as for what is besides it, it is interpretation.”

I said: “That is because they believed, then disbelieved.” He said: “Allah, Blessed and Exalted, named those who did not follow His Messenger concerning the wilayah of his legatee as hypocrites, and He made the one who denies the Imamate of his legatee like one who denies Muḥammad. And He sent down Qurʾan regarding that, saying: ‘O Muḥammad, when the hypocrites come to you’ with the wilayah of your legatee, ‘they say: We testify that you are surely the Messenger of Allah, and Allah knows that you are surely His Messenger, and Allah testifies that the hypocrites,’ regarding the wilayah of ʿAlī, ‘are surely liars. They took their oaths as a shield, so they turned away from the way of Allah’ — and the way is the legatee — ‘surely evil is what they were doing. That is because they believed in your messengership and disbelieved in the wilayah of your legatee, so Allah sealed their hearts, thus they do not understand.’”

I said: “What is the meaning of ‘they do not understand’?” He said: “He says: ‘They do not comprehend your prophethood.’” I said: “And when it is said to them: Come, the Messenger of Allah will seek forgiveness for you?” He said: “And when it is said to them: Return to the wilayah of ʿAlī, the Prophet will seek forgiveness for your sins, they twist their heads.” Allah said: “And you see them turning away from the wilayah of ʿAlī while they are arrogant toward it.”

Then the statement turned from Allah by His knowledge of them, and He said: “It is the same for them whether you seek forgiveness for them or do not seek forgiveness for them; Allah will never forgive them. Surely Allah does not guide the defiantly disobedient people,” meaning: those who are unjust to your legatee.

I said: “Is one who walks fallen upon his face better guided, or one who walks upright upon a straight path?” He said: “Allah has struck the likeness of one who turned away from the wilayah of ʿAlī as one who walks on his face, not guided in his affair; and He made the one who follows him upright upon a straight path. And the straight path is Amīr al-Muʾminīn عليه السلام.”

He said: I said: “His saying: ‘Indeed, it is surely the word of a noble messenger.’” He said: “Meaning Jibrāʾīl from Allah concerning the wilayah of ʿAlī عليه السلام.” I said: “‘And it is not the word of a poet; little is it that you believe.’” He said: “They said that Muḥammad is a liar against his Lord, and Allah did not command him with this regarding ʿAlī. So Allah sent down Qurʾan about that, and said: ‘Indeed, the wilayah of ʿAlī is a revelation from the Lord of the worlds. And if Muḥammad had fabricated against Us some statements, We would have seized him by the right hand, then We would have cut from him the aorta.’”

Then the discourse turned, and He said: “Indeed, the wilayah of ʿAlī is surely a reminder for the Godwary, for the worlds; and We certainly know that among you are deniers. And indeed ʿAlī is surely a regret for the disbelievers. And indeed his wilayah is surely the truth of certainty. So glorify, O Muḥammad, the Name of your Lord, the Magnificent,” meaning: thank your Magnificent Lord Who gave you this grace.

I said: “His saying: ‘When we heard the guidance, we believed in it.’” He said: “The guidance is the wilayah. We believed in our master. So whoever believes in the wilayah of his master shall fear neither diminution nor oppression.” I said: “Is this revelation?” He said: “No, interpretation.”

I said: “His saying: ‘I do not possess for you harm nor right guidance.’” He said: “The Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله called the people to the wilayah of ʿAlī, so Quraysh gathered before him and said: ‘O Muḥammad, excuse us from this.’ The Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله said to them: ‘This belongs to Allah, not to me.’ So they accused him and left his presence.”

So Allah sent down: “Say: I do not possess for you harm nor right guidance. Say: No one can protect me from Allah, if I disobey Him, and I shall never find besides Him any refuge — except a conveyance from Allah and His messages regarding ʿAlī.” I said: “Is this revelation?” He said: “Yes.” Then he said by way of emphasis: “And whoever disobeys Allah and His Messenger regarding the wilayah of ʿAlī — for him shall be the Fire of Hell, abiding therein forever.”
I said: “Until when they see what they are promised, then they will know who is weaker in helpers and fewer in number?” He said: “By that is meant al-Qāʾim and his supporters.”

I said: “‘And be patient over what they say.’” He said: “What they say about you. ‘And forsake them with a gracious forsaking. And leave Me, O Muḥammad, with the deniers of your legatee, possessors of ease, and grant them a little respite.’” I said: “Is this revelation?” He said: “Yes.”

I said: “‘So that those who were given the Book may attain certainty.’” He said: “That they become certain that Allah, His Messenger, and his legatee are true.” I said: “‘And those who believe may increase in faith.’” He said: “And they increase in faith through the wilayah of the legatee.” I said: “‘And those who were given the Book and the believers may not doubt.’” He said: “Regarding the wilayah of ʿAlī عليه السلام.” I said: “What is this doubt?” He said: “By that are meant the People of the Book and the believers whom Allah mentioned; thus He said: ‘And they do not doubt concerning the wilayah.’”

I said: “‘And it is nothing but a reminder to mankind.’” He said: “Yes — the wilayah of ʿAlī عليه السلام.” I said: “‘Indeed it is surely one of the greatest matters.’” He said: “The wilayah.” I said: “‘For whoever among you wishes to go forward or stay behind.’” He said: “Whoever goes forward to our wilayah is held back from Saqar, and whoever lags behind from us goes forward to Saqar — except the people of the right hand.” He said: “They, by Allah, are our Shiʿah.”

I said: “‘We were not among those who prayed.’” He said: “Meaning: we did not take as wali the legatee of Muḥammad and the legatees after him, nor did they send salat upon them.” I said: “‘So what is wrong with them that they turn away from the reminder?’” He said: “Turning away from the wilayah.” I said: “‘No indeed, it is surely a reminder.’” He said: “The wilayah.”
I said: “His saying: ‘They fulfill vows.’” He said: “They fulfill for Allah the vow that He took from them in the covenant concerning our wilayah.”

I said: “‘Indeed We have sent down to you the Qurʾan, a sending down.’” He said: “With the wilayah of ʿAlī عليه السلام, a sending down.” I said: “Is this revelation?” He said: “Yes; that is interpretation.” I said: “‘Indeed this is a reminder.’” He said: “The wilayah.” I said: “‘He admits whom He wills into His mercy.’” He said: “Into our wilayah.” Then he said: “‘And for the wrongdoers He has prepared a painful punishment.’ Do you not see that Allah says: ‘They did not wrong Us, but rather they were wronging themselves’?”

He said: “Allah is too mighty and too exalted to wrong anyone or to ascribe oppression to Himself. But Allah has joined us to Himself, so He made wronging us to be wronging Him, and our wilayah to be His wilayah. Then He sent down Qurʾan regarding that upon His Prophet, and said: ‘And We did not wrong them, but they were wronging themselves.’” I said: “Is this revelation?” He said: “Yes.”

I said: “‘Woe that Day to the deniers.’” He said: “Meaning: Woe to the deniers, O Muḥammad, of what I revealed to you concerning the wilayah of ʿAlī ibn Abī Ṭālib عليه السلام. ‘Did We not destroy the former ones? Then We made the later ones follow them.’” He said: “The former ones are those who denied the messengers regarding obedience to the legatees. ‘Thus do We deal with the guilty’ — meaning those who acted criminally toward the family of Muḥammad and did concerning his legatee what they did.”
I said: “‘Indeed the Godwary...’” He said: “By Allah, it is us and our Shiʿah. None besides us is upon the creed of Ibrāhīm, and the rest of the people are free of it.”

I said: “‘The Day when the Spirit and the angels stand in ranks; they do not speak...’ — the verse.” He said: “By Allah, we are those permitted for them on the Day of Resurrection, and those who speak rightly.” I said: “What will you say when you speak?” He said: “We glorify our Lord, send salat upon our Prophet, and intercede for our Shiʿah, and our Lord will not reject us.”
I said: “‘No indeed, the record of the wicked is surely in Sijjīn.’” He said: “They are those who acted wickedly regarding the right of the Imams and transgressed against them.”
I said: “‘Then it will be said: This is that which you used to deny.’” He said: “Meaning Amīr al-Muʾminīn.” I said: “Is this revelation?” He said: “Yes.”

key_terms.الصِّرَاطُ الْمُسْتَقِيمُ: the straight path, interpreted here as Amīr al-Muʾminīn عليه السلام
key_terms.النُّورُ: the divine light interpreted here as the Imam
key_terms.الْإِمَامَةُ: the divinely ordained leadership of the Imam
key_terms.الْقَائِمُ: the awaited Imam whose rise will manifest the truth over all religions
key_terms.تَأْوِيلٌ: interpretive meaning or inner referent of the verse
key_terms.شِيعَتُنَا: the followers and loyal adherents of the Ahl al-Bayt عليهم السلام
key_terms.وَلَايَةُ: divinely mandated authority and loyalty, here referring especially to the authority of ʿAlī عليه السلام and the Ahl al-Bayt عليهم السلام

ai.seo_question: How does this hadith from al-Kāfī interpret Qurʾanic verses about light, guidance, and religion in relation to the wilayah of ʿAlī عليه السلام?
ai.summary: This hadith presents an extended Qurʾanic commentary in which numerous verses are interpreted in relation to the wilayah and Imamate of Amīr al-Muʾminīn ʿAlī عليه السلام and the Ahl al-Bayt عليهم السلام. It emphasizes that divine guidance, true religion, salvation, and ultimate vindication are bound to loyalty to the Imam, while rejection of wilayah is portrayed as hypocrisy, deviation, and a cause of punishment.
